components.author: DavidR
components.name: Meta Name Picker
components.info: A picker for standard meta data names.
components.summary: 从标准元数据名称里挑一个，例如烘焙图层、名称字段。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Colour
components.info: Digital colour. Colours can be expressed in a variety of different models, including RGB, HSL, XYZ, and L*a*b*.
components.summary: 承载颜色的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Connection
components.info: Wire connection. A topological connection between two parameters. A connection is strictly used to specify relationships between Grasshopper objects, it does not ferry any actual data.
components.summary: 承载连线关系的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Generic
components.info: Generic data. This parameter can contain any kind of data.
components.summary: 可承载任意类型数据的通用参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Gradient
components.info: Colour Gradient. A one-dimensional colour progression.
components.summary: 承载颜色渐变的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Text
components.info: Text. A sequence of textual characters with no additional formatting or type-setting.
components.summary: 承载纯文本的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Text Pattern
components.info: Text Pattern. A search or text matching pattern used in text comparisons.
components.summary: 承载文本匹配模式的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Identifier
components.info: Unique Identifier. A 128-bit ID code typically used to identify elements in unordered collections, e.g. objects in the Rhino document.
components.summary: 承载 GUID 标识符的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Language
components.info: Cultural language. A linguistic culture specifier, encoding text sorting rules as well as number, date and currency formatting.
components.summary: 承载语言选项的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Meta Data
components.info: Meta data. A collection of one or more named values storing additional information linked to regular data.
components.summary: 承载元数据条目的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Meta Name
components.info: Meta name. A textual key identifying a specific meta value in a collection of meta data.
components.summary: 承载元数据名称的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Path
components.info: Tree Path. A sequence of non-negative integers identifying individual lists in data trees.
components.summary: 承载数据树路径（一串非负整数）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Site
components.info: Tree site. A path & index pair, identifying individual items in data trees. The path element identifies the twig in the tree, and the index identifies the item within that twig.
components.summary: 承载「路径 + 索引」位置标识的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Tuple
components.info: Value Tuple. A group of named values acting as a single value.
components.summary: 承载一组命名值的元组参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Box
components.info: Volumetric box. An oriented box with six perpendicular faces.
components.summary: 承载盒体（Box）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Circle
components.info: Circle. An oriented circle in three-dimensional space.
components.summary: 承载圆的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Curve
components.info: Curve. This parameter supports all curve types, including lines, arcs, polylines, rectangles and NURBS curves.
components.summary: 承载曲线的参数对象，接受所有曲线类型。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Field
components.info: Scalar or vector field. A three-dimensional, volumetric entity with locally differing values.
components.summary: 承载场（Field）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Mesh
components.info: Mesh. A type of surface geometry consisting of a discrete patchwork of polygonal facets.
components.summary: 承载网格的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Plane
components.info: Infinite plane. An infinite, flat plane in three-dimensional space, defined by an origin point and axis vectors.
components.summary: 承载无限平面的参数对象，由原点与坐标轴定义。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Point
components.info: Three-dimensional point. A point defined by Cartesian coordinates in a flat, three-dimensional space.
components.summary: 承载三维点的参数对象，由笛卡尔坐标定义。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Point 2
components.info: Two-dimensional point. A point defined by Cartesian coordinates in a flat, two-dimensional space.
components.summary: 承载二维平面坐标点的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Point N
components.info: N-dimensional point. A point defined by a variable number of independent coordinates.
components.summary: 承载任意维数点的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Rectangle
components.info: Rectangle. An oriented rectangular curve in three-dimensional space.
components.summary: 承载矩形的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Surface
components.info: Surface. This parameter supports all surface types, including trimmed surfaces, polysurfaces, extrusions and subdivision surfaces.
components.summary: 承载曲面或多重曲面的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: TextDot
components.info: Text dot. A point in 3D space with an associated label text.
components.summary: 承载「点 + 标签文字」的文字点参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Vector
components.info: Vector. A direction and a magnitude aligned with the world Cartesian axes in three-dimensional space.
components.summary: 承载向量的参数对象，含方向与长度。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Deform
components.info: Squishy Deformation. A non-linear deformation in three-dimensional space, i.e. when lines are deformed, they may become curved.
components.summary: 承载空间变形（Deform）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Transform
components.info: Linear Transformation. A line-preserving three-dimensional transformation.
components.summary: 承载线性变换的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: View
components.info: View Projection. A camera and target pairing with projection properties.
components.summary: 承载相机视图（含投影属性）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Line
components.info: Line. A linear curve between two end points in three-dimensional space. Depending on context, lines can be treated as finite or infinite entities.
components.summary: 承载直线的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Polyline
components.info: Polyline. A type of discrete curve made up of a chain of consecutive line segments.
components.summary: 承载多段线（折线）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Triangle
components.info: Triangle. A closed curve containing three linear segments connecting three points.
components.summary: 承载三角形的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Arc
components.info: Circular arc. Arcs are subsets of circles defined by start and sweep angles.
components.summary: 承载圆弧的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Curve Locus
components.info: Curve Locus. A position along a curve which can be expressed in a variety of different ways, including domain-parameter, arc-length and closest-point.
components.summary: 承载曲线上某位置（曲线轨迹点）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Region
components.info: A planar region consisting of one or more outer boundaries and optional holes.
components.summary: 承载平面区域（可带洞）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cage
components.info: Volumetric cage. A squishy, deformable cage with box topology.
components.summary: 承载变形控制框（Cage）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Sphere
components.info: Sphere. An oriented spherical surface in three-dimensional space.
components.summary: 承载球体的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Surface Locus
components.info: Surface Locus. A position on a surface which can be expressed either as $(u,v)$ parameters, or as a closest point.
components.summary: 承载曲面上某位置（UV 或三维点）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Tube
components.info: Tube. An oriented tubular surface. Tubes can represent cylinders, cones, and truncated cones, all with or without walls.
components.summary: 承载管状曲面的参数对象，可表示圆柱、圆锥。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Graph
components.info: A collection of nodes connected by one-way and two-way edges.
components.summary: 承载图结构（节点与边）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Mesh Facet
components.info: Mesh Facet. A triangular or quadrangular facet connecting three or four mesh vertices.
components.summary: 承载单个网格面（Facet）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Button
components.info: A button with an Up and a Down state.
components.summary: 带按下与弹起两个状态的按钮，用来手动触发一次计算。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Complex Picker
components.info: A picker for selecting complex numbers in the complex plane.
components.summary: 在复平面上点选一个复数。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Date Picker
components.info: A picker for selecting a moment in time.
components.summary: 选取一个时间点（日期）。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Gradient Editor
components.info: An editor for colour gradients.
components.summary: 编辑颜色渐变，并输出可供着色使用的渐变对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Numberline
components.info: A number picker with a numberline.
components.summary: 在数轴上拖动取值，比滑块更适合大范围数值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Protractor
components.info: A set of rotating dials for angle input.
components.summary: 一组可旋转的表盘，用来输入角度。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Slider
components.info: Number slider.
components.summary: 拖动取一个数值，最常用的参数输入方式。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Value List
components.info: A filtered list of user defined, named values.
components.summary: 用户自定义的命名值列表，可按名称筛选取值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Colour Swatch
components.info: A colour swatch.
components.summary: 一块颜色样本，用来取色与配色。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Display Material
components.info: Display material.
components.summary: 设置预览时使用的显示材质。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Image Sampler
components.info: Sample colours or their properties from an image.
components.summary: 从图片上采样颜色或颜色属性，常用来做参数化纹理。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Function Editor
components.info: An editor for functions in the form $f:X→Y$, with both $X$ and $Y$ being normal numbers.
components.summary: 编辑 f:X→Y 形式的函数，输入输出都是普通数值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Text Input
components.info: An input object for textual values.
components.summary: 手动输入一段文本值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Value
components.info: Define one or more values using text. Double click to enter text edit mode.
components.summary: 定义一个常量值，可承载单个值或一列值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Constant Picker
components.info: A picker for predefined constant values.
components.summary: 从预定义常量里挑一个值，例如圆周率、自然常数。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Preset Picker
components.info: A picker for selecting presets defined in connected parameters.
components.summary: 从上游参数定义的预设里挑一个。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Toggle
components.info: A simple boolean toggle. Double click to switch between states.
components.summary: 布尔开关，双击在真与假之间切换。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Angle
components.info: Angle value. Angles may be expressed in various units, including degrees, radians, turns and grades.
components.summary: 承载角度值的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Boolean
components.info: Boolean value. A boolean can only be either false or true.
components.summary: 承载真/假值的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Complex
components.info: Complex number. Complex values consist of a real-imaginary number pair.
components.summary: 承载复数的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Integer
components.info: Integer number. A signed, whole number without a fractional part with a valid range from roughly -2 billion to +2 billion.
components.summary: 承载整数的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Number
components.info: Decimal number. A signed number with a fractional part. Numbers can represent both very small and very large values, but are limited to about 16 significant digits regardless of their magnitude.
components.summary: 承载浮点数的参数对象，最常用的输入。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Numeric
components.info: Numeric value. This parameter supports many different kinds of numbers, including decimals, limitless integers, angles and complex numbers.
components.summary: 数值类参数的通用形态，可承载整数或浮点。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Function
components.info: Mathematical Function. A univariate function of the form $f:X→Y$, with both $X$ and $Y$ being normal numbers.
components.summary: 承载函数对象的参数对象，可交给求值组件使用。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Interval
components.info: Numeric interval. A consecutive stretch of numbers extending from a lower to an upper limit.
components.summary: 承载数值区间的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: C-Distribution
components.info: Continuous distribution. A continuous statistical probability distribution.
components.summary: 承载连续概率分布（如正态分布）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: D-Distribution
components.info: Discrete distribution. A discrete statistical probability distribution.
components.summary: 承载离散概率分布（如二项分布）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Random
components.info: Random engine. A pseudo-random number generator tied to an integral seed value.
components.summary: 承载伪随机数生成器的参数对象，可用种子复现。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Date
components.info: Calendar Date. A day in the Gregorian calendar, with an optional time-of-day component. Valid dates are defined between the beginning of 1 CE and the end of 9999 CE.
components.summary: 承载日期时间值的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Time
components.info: Time. A span of time expressed in days, hours, minutes and seconds.
components.summary: 承载时间跨度（天/时/分/秒）的参数对象。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cherry Picker
components.info: Pick twigs and items from the data tree flowing through this object.
components.summary: 从流经此对象的数据树里挑出指定的枝与项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Curve Graph
components.info: A graph which plots curve properties against parameters or arc-lengths.
components.summary: 把曲线属性随参数或弧长的变化画成图表。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Histogram
components.info: A histogram representation of number distributions.
components.summary: 用柱状图展示数值分布，一眼看出集中与离散。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Listen
components.info: Collect data emitted by a matching Shout object.
components.summary: 接收同名 Shout 广播出来的数据，实现不连线的无线传值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Panel
components.info: A panel for viewing and examining values.
components.summary: 查看与检查数据的文本面板，最常用的调试工具。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Path Mapper
components.info: Apply custom path and item mapping rules to all the values in a data tree.
components.summary: 用规则批量改写数据树里所有值的路径与项索引。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Tree Viewer
components.info: Display the tree structure of data visually.
components.summary: 以可视化结构展示数据树的分支与项。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Data Recorder
components.info: Record all data flowing through this object.
components.summary: 记录流经此对象的全部数据，用于回溯每次计算的结果。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Relay
components.info: A wire relay with additional organisational features. Double click a relay to freeze or thaw it.
components.summary: 一根带整理功能的连线中继，双击可冻结或穿线，用来理顺长距离连线。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Shout
components.info: An object which broadcasts its values to all parameters and expressions willing to listen.
components.summary: 把数据广播给所有愿意接收的 Listen 与表达式，实现不连线的无线传值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Geometry Stash
components.info: Store shapes in the Rhino document, or retrieve previously stashed shapes.
components.summary: 把形体存进 Rhino 文档，或取回之前存下的形体。
